titleDv: ޤާނޫނު ނަންބަރު 31/79 (ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ އެކްސްޕޯޓް އިމްޕޯޓް ޤާނޫނު) އަށް 20 ވަނަ އިޞްލާޙު ގެނައުމުގެ ބިލު
summary: This amendment rewrites the import duty rates for tobacco in Chapter 24 of the tariff schedule. Most tobacco products are charged 200%. Cigarettes, bidis and heat-not-burn sticks are charged 30% plus MVR 4 per piece. Nicotine replacement therapy products for quitting tobacco get a new 0% rate. Two duty exemptions in Article 5 are reworded so they apply only when the conditions in the related regulation are met.
whyItMatters: Every imported cigarette, bidi or heated tobacco stick would carry a fixed MVR 4 duty on top of 30%, which raises prices. Nicotine replacement products for people trying to quit would come in duty-free.
keyProvisions: Chapter 24 (tobacco and tobacco substitutes), item (h): all tobacco products not listed separately are charged 200% import duty
Item (n), cigarettes: 30% plus MVR 4 per cigarette
Item (s), bidis: 30% plus MVR 4 per bidi
Item (b), heat-not-burn tobacco products and their consumables: 30% plus MVR 4 per stick
New item added after (b): nicotine replacement therapy products used to stop tobacco use are charged 0%

Two sub-clauses of Article 5 are reworded so the duty exemptions they cover depend on meeting the conditions in the regulation; regulations must be updated within 30 days, and the law takes effect when published in the Gazette
whoIsAffected: Smokers and users of bidis or heated tobacco, tobacco importers and shops, and people using nicotine replacement products to quit.
